contact.model: 269-node CRBN, statically relaxed DDB1 Schur complement
contact.target: fixed ensemble open-minus-closed displacement, projected off each reference CRBN rigid subspace and normalized; fixed under perturbation
contact.primary_metric: delta log S_close; S_close=(q^T H_eff^+ q)/(trace(P H_eff^+ P)/(3N-6))
contact.candidate_unit: CRBN author residue x contact class
contact.ranking: abs((log S(1.1)-log S(0.9))/0.2), descending within class; tie author residue ascending
contact.control_matching: same class and CRBN domain; exclude identical edge sets; exact contact count first; if fewer than 10 use all three fixed calipers
contact.robust_rule: same nonzero sign, rank/number_of_candidates <=0.20 in every condition, no additional zero modes
